title: Status board
summary: A local status board per repository, rendered from the checklist and progress files at fixed moments.
why: A page you open in a browser shows a repository's plan and progress, and rendering it costs no model time.

items.title: Status board renderer
items.does: Copies kit_board.py, which renders the board deterministically from the checklist and progress files into one local page; nothing is published.
items.why: Rendering from files rather than from the model keeps each render cheap and the board identical to the real state.

items.title: Board rendered only at fixed moments
items.does: Adds the rule that the board is rendered at session start, after each checklist reprint and at /done, and the /done step for the final render.
items.why: A bounded number of renders keeps the board's cost predictable.
